evals.prompt: 帮我 review 这次 PR 的后端改动，重点看支付回调和幂等处理。请用中文给我一个可以直接贴到评审里的结论，别只写 LGTM，要把阻塞问题和建议修改分开。
evals.expected_output: 中文输出，先给 findings，再给结论；阻塞问题使用明确的中文分级，并给出可执行建议。
assertions: The review is written in Chinese.
Findings are presented before the summary or conclusion.
Blocking issues use explicit Chinese severity labels such as [必须修复] / [建议修改] / [仅供参考].
Each blocking finding includes a concrete, actionable recommendation rather than a bare LGTM.

evals.prompt: 请审查当前 git changes，代码是 React + TypeScript。团队平时中文沟通，但代码和类型名都保留英文。请重点看 hooks 依赖、内存泄漏和测试缺口。
evals.expected_output: 中文为主、英文技术术语保留原样，指出 React 和 TypeScript 相关风险，不应把纯样式问题抬成高优先级。
assertions: The review is in Chinese while keeping English identifiers, type names, and APIs unchanged.
The review flags React/TypeScript-specific risks such as hook dependencies, memory leaks, or missing tests.
Pure formatting or style issues are not escalated above low severity.

evals.prompt: Review the changes in src/auth and tests/auth before merge. I want a concise English review comment that calls out only real risks, especially auth bypass, token handling, and missing edge-case tests.
evals.expected_output: English output with findings first, concrete auth and testing concerns, and no forced Chinese wording.
assertions: The review is written in English.
Findings are presented first, before any summary.
The review raises concrete authentication and testing concerns such as auth bypass, token handling, or missing edge-case tests.
No Chinese wording is forced into the English review.

evals.prompt: 看一下 services/order 和 api/order.ts 这几处改动。我想确认逻辑有没有问题，如果有不确定作者意图的地方，请直接提问，不要装作很确定。另外如果整体没大问题，也请写出你检查了哪些方面。
evals.expected_output: 中文输出，能在不确定时使用问题式反馈；如果没有阻塞问题，也要明确列出检查范围和结论。
assertions: The review is written in Chinese.
When author intent is uncertain, feedback is phrased as questions instead of overconfident assertions.
If no blocking issues exist, the review still states what was checked and gives a conclusion rather than an empty LGTM.

evals.prompt: 这个项目维护性怎么样？帮我从架构和可维护性角度评估一下 src/ 整体结构，看看抽象是不是合理、有没有该拆的大文件。
evals.expected_output: 近邻负例：纯可维护性/结构质量审查更适合 code-quality-review；code-auditor 是覆盖正确性、安全、性能、可读性、测试、架构的全维度审查。
assertions: The skill description should not capture maintainability-only or structure-quality-only review requests that belong to code-quality-review.
If answered here, the response should still run the full multi-dimension audit rather than only a maintainability lens, or hand off to code-quality-review.

evals.prompt: 对这个项目做一次全维度的代码审计，正确性、安全、性能、可读性、测试和架构都要看。
evals.expected_output: Route to the project audit, orient before judging, and return the report in chat by default while offering rather than forcing a dated file.
assertions: The request routes to the project audit and covers all six dimensions together.
The audit builds a repository mental model and identifies scope or hotspots before presenting findings.
The completed report is presented in chat by default.
Saving a collision-safe dated report is offered as an explicit opt-in rather than performed automatically.

evals.prompt: Do a deep full-spectrum audit of this repo, including architecture debt alongside correctness, security, performance, readability, and tests.
evals.expected_output: Use the deep project tier and produce an evidence-grounded findings table with location, severity, effort, recommendations, and the required anti-shallow-audit sections.
assertions: The audit selects the deep project tier instead of asking the user to narrow the repository scope.
The findings table includes file:line, severity, effort, and recommendation fields.
Every critical or high finding has exact file:line evidence.
The report includes Looks Bad but Is Actually Fine and Open Questions; the former may explicitly state that no reliable instance was found.
The report remains in chat unless the user explicitly opts in to saving it.

evals.prompt: Audit this codebase again. There is already a previous code-audit report in docs/audits; tell me what changed since then.
evals.expected_output: Use delta mode against the latest dated report without overwriting it, update prior finding statuses, and separate new findings.
assertions: The audit compares against the latest dated code-audit report in docs/audits.
Prior findings are classified as Fixed, Partially Fixed, or Still Present.
New findings are separated from prior-finding status updates.
If the user later opts in to saving, the output uses a collision-safe filename and never overwrites the baseline.

evals.prompt: 给我一份包含合规、隐私、无障碍、成本和发布准备度的仓库健康报告。
evals.expected_output: Near-negative: a repository health report spanning non-code dimensions should route to the broader repository-health workflow, not code-auditor.
assertions: The skill description should not capture repository health reports spanning compliance, privacy, accessibility, cost, or other non-code dimensions.
The request is handed off to a broader repository-health audit workflow rather than reduced to code-auditor's six code dimensions.
